featured_title: Closing in December? Who Pays the 2026 Property Tax Bill? Southwest Florida 2026
featured_excerpt: On a November or December closing in Southwest Florida, the 2026 property tax bill is usually paid in full at closing at the 4% or 3% early-payment discount, and your buyer credits you back for their days. If your closing slips to January, the whole 2026 bill is yours.
